author: Vox
description:
What did the Biden administration get wrong? 

Former adviser Neera Tanden tells Vox’s Astead Herndon that the administration made a central mistake by pitching Biden’s presidency as a “restoration” at a time when voters were demanding change. She also says Democrats need to acknowledge policy failures, including on immigration, that helped pave the way for Donald Trump’s return.

author: Vox
description:
Progressives are racking up primary wins. Is the Democratic establishment getting the message?

In a special episode of America, Actually, Vox’s Astead Herndon speaks to Democratic strategist Neera Tanden, president and CEO of the Center for American Progress, to discuss what it will take to build a coalition capable of defeating Trump. Tanden discusses the failures of the Biden era, the party’s need to win back working-class voters, and the ideological divide on AIPAC, Israel, and the Iran war.

author: Vox
description:
As the price of everything rises, millennials are looking to their parents for help. Although a majority of parents in America help their children financially in some capacity, there is a contingent of boomers who insist their children pull themselves up by their bootstraps. 

Charlotte Cowles, a financial columnist for The Cut, spoke to some of these millennials and their boomer parents about why the kids want the money now and why their parents want to wait. She told Vox’s Today, Explained podcast that the assumptions about money made by both the parents and children are stopping families from having much-needed conversations about finances.
